name: anemos
description: Anemos Concierge: guest answers + live chat with the front desk

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend && npm start --prefix backend
